question: What is the slope of the line passing through points (2,3) and (4,7)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Slope (m) is the ratio of the vertical change to the horizontal change between two points.

m = (Change in y) ÷ (Change in x)

m = (7 − 3) ÷ (4 − 2)

m = 4 ÷ 2 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**
